description: This file defines a utility function to compute a comfort score for outdoor conditions based on temperature, wind, humidity, air quality, and UV index. The function heuristically weights different environmental factors to produce a score from 1 to 10 indicating the suitability of going outside.

methods.name: computeComfortScore({ temperature,  wind,  humidity,  airQuality,  uvIndex })
methods.description: Calculates a comfort score (1-10) based on environmental factors: temperature, wind, humidity, air quality index, and UV index. Factors are heuristically weighted to reflect outdoor comfort levels.
